title: Knowledge of cultural moral norms in large language models

bias_targets.methodology: Probing language models with country-specific prompts about moral topics (e.g., 'In [Country] [Topic] is [Moral judgement]') and comparing the model's probability-based moral scores to empirical human ratings from the World Values Survey and PEW Global Attitudes survey. The evaluation measures how well models align with the moral norms of different countries, specifically comparing performance across cultural and economic clusters like 'Rich West' versus non-Western and non-rich countries.
